name: dip-utensil
title: Dip a utensil
description: Lower a held spoon's far end into a container below its rim, hold it there and lift it out.
use_when: A held utensil must go into a container briefly (taste, wet).

not_to_be_confused_with.stir: stir circles inside the container; dip goes in and out once.

preconditions.name: holding
preconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: uncovered
preconditions.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: dipped
postconditions.meaning: A held utensil tip entered the container below its rim and came back out.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: holding
postconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: dipped
checks.meaning: A held utensil tip entered the container below its rim and came back out.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: holding
checks.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
